home.welcomeIntro: Pick your board and an image. We'll download it, write it to your SD card or USB drive, and verify it for you.
home.offlineHint: Flash from a local file or an image you downloaded earlier.

modal.insertDevice: Insert an SD card or USB drive
modal.rollingBuildMessage: Rolling-release images are built automatically from the latest code. They can contain untested changes and bugs, so they may not boot or work correctly.
modal.communityBoardMessage: This board is maintained by the community, so its images may not boot or work correctly and support is limited. Use the official builds when you can.

device.qdlNotFound: No EDL device found. Put your board in EDL mode and connect via USB.
device.qdlInstructions: Place the jumper on the JCTL pins, then connect the USB-C cable.
device.qdlInstructionsButton: Hold the EDL button while powering on, then connect the USB cable.

errorDisplay.scanQrOrShare: Scan the QR code or share this link:

error.writeFailed: Writing to the device failed at {{offset}}. The device may be too small, failing, or the reader was disconnected. Try another card, reader, or port.
error.qdlDisconnected: Device disconnected during flash. Reconnect in EDL mode and retry.
error.qdlPermissionDenied: USB access denied. On Linux, install udev rules: echo 'SUBSYSTEM=="usb", ATTR{idVendor}=="05c6", ATTR{idProduct}=="9008", MODE="0666"' | sudo tee /etc/udev/rules.d/51-qdl.rules && echo 'blacklist qcserial' | sudo tee /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-qcserial.conf && sudo udevadm control --reload-rules
error.qdlConnectionFailed: Couldn't connect to the EDL device. Make sure it's in EDL mode and connected via USB.
error.qdlAutoconfigFailed: Failed to apply the autoconfig profile to the QDL image.
error.autoconfigNotArmbian: This image has no Armbian first-boot setup, so the profile can't be applied. Flash it without a profile or pick an Armbian image.
error.deviceInvalidPath: This device can't be written to. Select the device again.
error.deviceNotFound: The selected device is no longer connected. Reconnect it and select it again.
error.deviceChanged: The selected device changed since you picked it. Select it again before writing.
error.deviceReadOnly: The device is write-protected. Slide the card's lock switch off and try again.
error.deviceSystemBlocked: This is a system drive. Turn on "Allow system drives" in Settings to write to it.
error.deviceTooSmall: The image needs {{needed}} but the device holds only {{available}}. Use a larger device.
error.qdlDeviceNotFound: The selected EDL device is no longer connected. Reconnect it in EDL mode and select it again.
error.qdlMultipleDevices: Several EDL devices are connected and the selected one can't be identified. Connect only the board you want to flash.
error.shaMismatch: The downloaded image is damaged: its checksum doesn't match. Try again to download a fresh copy.
error.verifyMismatch: What was written to the device doesn't match the image. The card may be failing. Try another card.
error.verifyReadFailed: The device couldn't be read back to verify the write. Reconnect it and try again, or try another card or reader.
error.imageDecompressFailed: The image couldn't be decompressed. The file may be damaged or incomplete. Download it again or pick another file.
error.flashBusy: The previous flash is still finishing. Wait a moment and try again.

name.title: What should we call it?
name.sub: You pick it by name on the summary.

network.title: How does it connect?
network.sub: You can change it later in Settings.
network.cableLine: Plug the cable in before the first start. The board gets its address from your router.

user.title: Who logs in?
user.sub: The account you use on the board, for login and for sudo.
user.laterLine: The first time you log in, over SSH or with a keyboard and monitor, Armbian asks you to create it. The language and time from this profile are not applied then.

locale.title: Language and time
locale.sub: Set on the first login, whether or not a user is created now.
locale.locationLine: Armbian sets the language and time zone from where the board connects to the internet.

access.title: How do you get in?
access.sub: SSH keys let you log in without typing a password.
access.linkHint: Any https address that serves public keys, one per line.
access.passwordLine: You log in with your password, over SSH or with a keyboard and monitor.
